name: pose-rotate-root
description: Turning the root 90 degrees about Z (q = [0,0,sin45,cos45]) carries its children round it. upperleg01.L rests at root + (0.1019421, 0.0028925, -0.0114742); turned 90 degrees about Z, (x, y) -> (-y, x) gives root + (-0.0028925, 0.1019421, -0.0114742) = (-0.0028925, 0.0911192, 0.0389400). Starts from root offset 0 (the rest pose stands on the floor; 0 puts the root at its rest head).
